messages.author: 8f162f2b0fdf2878
messages.subject: mediation analysis
parts:
Hi,

I am attempting to do a mediation (path) analysis. I have four IVs, one Mediator and one Outcome variable. Being new to R, I am not sure if the syntax below is right? If anyone can help, please. Thank you!

IV1=~a1+a2+a3+a4+a5
IV2=~b1+b2+b3+b4+b5
IV3=~c1+c2+c3+c4+c5
IV4=~d1+d2+d3+d4+d5
M=~e1+e2+e3+e4+e5
O=~f1+f2+f3+f4+f5
M~IV1+IV2+IV3+IV4+IV5
O~M

For path analysis, should I do analysis for each IV separately (using SEM)?

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: mediation analysis
parts:
Adeela

You would need to include the IVs as predictors of the oitcome too, and include labels to estimate the indirect effects

M~ p1*IV1 + p2*IV2 + p3*IV3 + p4*IV4 + p5*IV5
O~ q1*M + cp1*IV1 + cp2*IV2 + cp3*IV3 + cp4*IV4 + cp5*IV5

## indirect effects
ind1 := p1*q1
ind2 := p2*q1
ind3 := p3*q1
ind4 := p4*q1
ind5 := p5*q1

Then you would need to use either bootstrap or monte carlo for the inference of the indirect effects
